common_commands.summary: Count spectra and non-empty decoded m/z and intensity arrays and values; include MS-level counts.
common_commands.fingerprint: Read every spectrum and emit a comparable normalized fingerprint.
common_commands.random: Read one spectrum by zero-based index, report its normalized shape, and identify the access mode.
common_commands.compare: Run available mzML peers and compare common summary fields, including chromatogram counts and the spectrum fingerprint; unsupported inputs are reported and skipped.
common_commands.benchmark: Time the common mzML fingerprint command and record wall time, maximum resident memory, and exit status.
common_commands.numpress-compare: Compare exact MS-Numpress encoded bytes and decoded values between the C++ and Rust codec peers.
common_commands.numpress-benchmark: Time standalone MS-Numpress round trips for linear, pic, and slof.

fingerprint.normalization: UTF-8 IDs, zero-based sequence index, MS level, reader-reported scan start time in minutes with missing values as zero, and m/z/intensity values converted to little-endian f64 before hashing
fingerprint.purpose: Comparison signal, not a cryptographic digest

tools.install: local Cargo build from tools/wrappers with Cargo.lock

tools.role: Python XML and binary-array reader peer
Python streaming and indexed reader peer
tools.note: The optional PyNumpress wheel is not installed. pymzML 2.6.1 still fails on some Numpress records in the checked fixtures; the adapter reports those inputs as unavailable. Its random-access adapter falls back to sequential lookup when the package cannot use a file index.
The optional Numpress extra is not installed because mzmlpy 0.3.1 calls the older camelCase PyNumpress API.

tools.role: broad C++ reader peer exposed through Python bindings
tools.install: isolated local Python virtual environment with the pyOpenMS wheel
tools.note: This does not install standalone OpenMS TOPP executables such as FileInfo. OpenMS exposes one retention time for a multi-scan spectrum; the adapter preserves that value instead of replacing it with another reader's scan value.

codec_peers.install: local g++ build from the pinned source commit
local Cargo build from tools/wrappers with Cargo.lock
codec_peers.note: mzdata 0.66.7 also depends on numpress-rs; use this peer against the C++ peer for the independent codec comparison.

not_included.role: vendor-file ingestion and mzML conversion candidate
not_included.note: Not installed because it writes mzML and is not a direct mzML reader.
No current stable release pin and portable local build recipe were established for this manifest.
The enabled pyOpenMS peer covers the same OpenMS library release; a separate CLI adds a large native build without a new reader API.
